description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Surrak and causing each opponent to make a copy of it.
Cast Orcish Bowmasters by paying {1}{B}.
When Orcish Bowmasters enters, it triggers, targeting a copy of Surrak.
Surrak's last ability triggers, causing its controller to draw a card.
Orcish Bowmasters triggers, targeting a copy of Surrak.
Repeat from step 4 until each opponent's library is empty, causing them to lose the game when they next attempt to draw.
